description: (0.5.0, Draft) Fail-open by default, fail-closed per tool (RFC-ACDP-0019 §7).

input.note: Run the proxy in front of a stub MCP server that returns the mcp-001 CallToolResult for tools/call regional_fraud_rate, against a test registry.

expected.behavior: Registry answers 429 rate_limited after retries: the upstream result is returned unchanged with io.acdp/provenance = {failed: true, error: "rate_limited"}.
Connection refused or the publish timeout elapses: result returned with io.acdp/provenance = {failed: true} and no error member.

For a tool configured fail-closed, the upstream content is withheld: the proxy returns a CallToolResult with isError true, a text content item naming the failure, and io.acdp/provenance = {failed: true, ...}.
Retries resend the byte-identical body with Idempotency-Key acdp-mcp-<content_hash hex>; the registry returns the original ctx_id, never a second publication.
